extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT must be paid before applying for grant of probate
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors seeks a £115,500 probate loan to pay inheritance tax on a £408,000 estate before applying for the grant, which is expected within about six weeks.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of the executors. We have noted the estate value of £408,000 and the £115,500 requested towards the inheritance tax liability ahead of the grant application. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the estate is being administered, a breakdown of the estate assets and any liabilities or charges, the IHT payment deadline, details of the executors and confirmation of your firm's instruction. Please also let us know whether any other funding or part payment is in place. Once we have those details a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
